readmeExcerpt: This module demonstrates how to use Oracle AI Database as the backend for a Spring Cloud Config Server. It includes a config server that stores configuration properties in an Oracle AI Database via JDBC, a simple client application that consumes these configurations, and a Docker Compose setup for the database.
highlights: Docker (for running the Oracle AI Database container)
metaTitle: Spring Cloud Config with Oracle AI Database | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Spring Cloud Config sample that stores configuration properties in Oracle AI Database.
